choose.when: HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0

HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

mapper.select:
SELECT TASK_ID AS taskId, COUNT(1) AS commandCount, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runningCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DEVICE_ID) AS deviceIds, MIN(CREATE_TIME) AS createTime, MAX(EXECUTED_TIME) AS lastExecutedTime FROM T_DEVICE_POINT_WRITE_COMMAND WHERE
GROUP BY TASK_ID
ORDER BY MAX(CREATE_TIME) DESC, TASK_ID DESC
